Messages.Author: M. Allen
Messages.Body:
The rules state that any ready minion with zero blood must hunt
as their action. My question is: Must they perform an action?
Or can I not do ANY action with a zero blood vampire, just to
have him available to block?

Thanks...

Messages.Author: James R. McClure Jr.
Messages.Body:


Peace Nobody,

If a vamp BEGINS the Minion Phase with zero blood, it must hunt and that
hunting must be the first action taken. If a vamp is untapped and has
zero blood at some other time in the Minion Phase (just rescued from
torpor, for example), it does not have to hunt immediately, BUT may perform
no other action. Yes, it could block after your turn is over.

Messages.Author: Stephen Beaulieu
Messages.Body:
In article <3su3ib$j...@hq.hq.af.mil>, "M. Allen" <nob...@somewhere.com> wrote:

: The rules state that any ready minion with zero blood must hunt
: as their action. My question is: Must they perform an action?
: Or can I not do ANY action with a zero blood vampire, just to
: have him available to block?

:
: Thanks...

If your minion starts the minion phase ready and with no blood on it, it
MUST hunt as its action. It does not have a choice to not act, or to do
something else. But remember that this is a very specific circumstance: 0
blood at the _start_ of the minion phase. So, if you rescue a vamp from
torpor and it comes out with 0 blood, you are not required to hunt that
turn as it was not ready at the start of the minion phase. But if it is
to take any action, it must hunt.

hope this helped

From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Revised Jyhad FAQ: 4/18/95 version
Date: 18 Apr 1995 23:01:44 GMT

Q: If I have a vampire that has no blood on it, do I have
to hunt with it right away?
A: If you start the minion phase with any vampires with no blood,
then those vampires must all hunt before any other actions can be
taken. Vampires with no blood can take no action other than
hunting, but they are only forced to hunt at the start of the
minion phase. For example, if your vampire that has no blood on
it is rescued from torpor, it can be left available to block until
your next minion phase.

Messages.Author: Gary S Cerefice
Messages.Body:
In article <3su3ib$j...@hq.hq.af.mil>, "M. Allen" <nob...@somewhere.com> writes:
|> The rules state that any ready minion with zero blood must hunt
|> as their action. My question is: Must they perform an action?
|> Or can I not do ANY action with a zero blood vampire, just to
|> have him available to block?
|>

|> Thanks...

If you have a vamp with 0 blood at the beginning of your minion phase,
you're first action must be to hunt with that vampire. The only exception to
this that I ahve seen is a minion with 0 blood and Talbot's Chainsaw. In this
case, the minion just sits there doing nothing (but can be used to block)

Gary

Hi Waz,
This is not strictly correct. If the vampire has no blood in your
untap phase then it must hunt as your first action in your minion phase.
If, however, the vampire ends up ready and zero blood during your turn
(ie. just got rescued from torpor) then you can choose not to hunt, so
long as the vamp takes no other action this turn.
